description: S5 exploration pass — rule complexity on one route (12 partitions, 1 KB, default maxInFlight 1000, i.e. the S2 p12 configuration whose knee is 65k ev/s). 1-min steps (20 s warm-up) locate each configuration's own knee; s5-confirm re-checks it with 5-min steps. Non-JS cases ramp 20k -> 90k, JS cases ramp 500 -> 10k (S1: ~0.8k ev/s per core).
